title: RadOnc-Agent：面向放疗全流程的LLM编排AI工作流框架
summary: 提出RadOnc-Agent，一个基于LLM控制器的智能体框架，将放疗流程形式化为四个临床阶段并提供26个可调用函数。系统通过对话接口映射临床意图到受模式约束的调用，保留患者与工作流上下文。在2600个单函数请求、200个跨阶段场景及120个真实患者工作流中，函数选择准确率达98.79%，跨阶段工作流完成率96.50%。消融实验表明纵向状态与模式验证对性能至关重要。
summary_en: Presents RadOnc-Agent, an agentic AI framework that formalizes radiotherapy into four clinical phases with 26 callable functions via a conversational interface. An LLM controller maps clinical intent to schema-constrained calls, preserving patient and workflow context. Evaluated on 2,600 single-function requests, 200 cross-stage scenarios, and 120 real-patient workflows, achieving 98.79% function selection accuracy and 96.50% cross-stage completion. Ablations show longitudinal state and schema validation are critical.
